provenance.source: Basque Language Institute (EHU), Cases and Postpositions; Berro & Fernández, Voice and Argument Structure in Basque, Cambridge University Press
provenance.note: Received grammatical witness. EHU states ergative -k, dative -i, absolutive zero; transitive subjects are ergative and transitive direct objects absolutive. Cambridge illustrates Ane-k Lea ... du. This seed intentionally covers only simple overt transitive proper-name clauses; it is not a general Basque morphological analyzer.

scope.supported: simple transitive clause with exactly one overt ergative proper-name phrase, one overt absolutive proper-name phrase, one main predicate, and final witnessed auxiliary du
scope.refuse: all other morphology, syncretism, plural case, dative arguments, omitted arguments, auxiliary variants, or clauses where the supported role assignment is not unique
